```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo       = FALSE,
  warning    = FALSE,
  message    = FALSE,
  fig.align  = "center"
)

library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(dplyr)
library(gamlss)

fit          <- params$fit
scored       <- params$scored
training     <- fit$training_data
scale_params <- fit$scale_params
predictors   <- fit$predictors
has_scored   <- !is.null(scored)

invisible(stopifnot(inherits(fit, "calmer_fit")))
```

# 1. Training summary

The model was fit on `r nrow(training)` reads sampled from primary
alignments. Predictors used: `r paste(predictors, collapse = ", ")`.

```{r training_predictor_ranges}
ranges <- lapply(predictors, function(p) {
  v <- training[[p]]
  data.frame(predictor = p,
             min       = min(v, na.rm = TRUE),
             median    = median(v, na.rm = TRUE),
             max       = max(v, na.rm = TRUE),
             sd        = sd(v, na.rm = TRUE))
}) |> dplyr::bind_rows()

knitr::kable(ranges, digits = 2, caption = "Predictor distributions on the training data.")
```

```{r mapq_dist, fig.height = 3.5, fig.cap = "Observed MAPQ distribution on training data."}
ggplot(training, aes(x = MAPQ)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 1, fill = "steelblue", color = "white", alpha = 0.85) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(0, 10, 20, 30, 40, 50, 60)) +
  labs(x = "MAPQ", y = "Count") +
  theme_minimal()
```

# 2. Model fit

```{r model_summary, results = "asis"}
cat("**Formulas used:**\n\n")
cat("- $\\mu$:    `",    deparse1(fit$formula$mu),    "`\n", sep = "")
cat("- $\\sigma$: `", deparse1(fit$formula$sigma), "`\n", sep = "")
cat("- $\\nu$:    `",    deparse1(fit$formula$nu),    "`\n", sep = "")
cat("- $\\tau$:   `",   deparse1(fit$formula$tau),   "`\n", sep = "")
```

```{r edf_table}
extract_edfs <- function(model, what) {
  smos <- tryCatch(
    lapply(seq_len(20), function(i) {
      x <- try(getSmo(model, what = what, which = i), silent = TRUE)
      if (inherits(x, "try-error")) NULL else x
    }),
    error = function(e) list()
  )
  smos <- Filter(Negate(is.null), smos)
  if (length(smos) == 0L) return(NULL)
  data.frame(
    parameter = what,
    term      = vapply(smos, function(x) if (!is.null(x$name)) x$name else NA_character_, character(1)),
    edf       = vapply(smos, function(x) if (!is.null(x$edf))  x$edf  else NA_real_,      numeric(1))
  )
}

edf_df <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  extract_edfs(fit$fit, "mu"),
  extract_edfs(fit$fit, "sigma"),
  extract_edfs(fit$fit, "nu"),
  extract_edfs(fit$fit, "tau")
)

if (!is.null(edf_df) && nrow(edf_df) > 0) {
  knitr::kable(edf_df, digits = 2,
               caption = "Effective degrees of freedom for each smooth term.")
}
```

```{r rsq, results = "asis"}
rsq <- tryCatch(round(gamlss::Rsq(fit$fit), 4), error = function(e) NA_real_)
cat("**Pseudo-$R^2$:** ", rsq, "\n", sep = "")
```

# 3. Residual diagnostics

Randomized quantile residuals (RQR) should be approximately $N(0, 1)$
under a correctly specified BEINF model.

```{r residuals_compute}
qr_train <- stats::residuals(fit$fit)
qr_df <- data.frame(qr = qr_train, n_isoforms = training$n_isoforms)
```

```{r qq_density, fig.height = 4, fig.cap = "Global QQ plot (left) and density vs N(0, 1) (right)."}
qq_pts <- stats::qqnorm(qr_train, plot.it = FALSE)
qq_df <- data.frame(theoretical = qq_pts$x, sample = qq_pts$y)

p_qq <- ggplot(qq_df, aes(x = theoretical, y = sample)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.3, size = 0.5) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, color = "red", linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(x = "Theoretical quantiles", y = "RQR") +
  theme_minimal()

p_dens <- ggplot(data.frame(qr = qr_train), aes(x = qr)) +
  geom_density(fill = "steelblue", alpha = 0.5) +
  stat_function(fun = dnorm, color = "red", linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(x = "RQR", y = "Density") +
  theme_minimal()

p_qq + p_dens
```

```{r resid_by_predictor, fig.height = 5, fig.cap = "RQR density faceted by predictor bins, with N(0, 1) reference (red dashed)."}
make_rqr_facet <- function(predictor_name, n_bins = 5) {
  values <- training[[predictor_name]]
  if (length(unique(values)) <= 10) {
    bin   <- factor(values)
    label <- predictor_name
  } else {
    qs    <- stats::quantile(values, seq(0, 1, length.out = n_bins + 1),
                             na.rm = TRUE)
    bin   <- cut(values, breaks = unique(qs), include.lowest = TRUE,
                 dig.lab = 4)
    label <- paste0(predictor_name, " (quantile bin)")
  }
  qr_df <- data.frame(qr = qr_train, bin = bin) |>
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(.data$bin))
  ggplot(qr_df, aes(x = qr)) +
    geom_density(fill = "steelblue", alpha = 0.5) +
    stat_function(fun = dnorm, color = "red", linetype = "dashed",
                  linewidth = 0.5) +
    facet_wrap(~ bin, scales = "free_y") +
    labs(x = "RQR", y = "Density", title = label) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 9)
}

for (p in predictors) {
  print(make_rqr_facet(p))
}
```

# 4. Partial effects on E[MAPQ]

Each panel varies one predictor over its training range while holding
the others at their training median, and shows the model's expected
MAPQ:

$$
E[Y] \;=\; \frac{\tau + \mu}{1 + \nu + \tau}, \qquad
E[\mathrm{MAPQ}] = 60 \cdot E[Y]
$$

```{r partial_effects_ey, fig.height = 4, fig.cap = "Partial effects on E[MAPQ]."}
n_grid <- 200
make_base_nd <- function(n) {
  base <- as.data.frame(lapply(predictors, function(p) {
    rep(stats::median(training[[paste0(p, "_sc")]], na.rm = TRUE), n)
  }))
  names(base) <- paste0(predictors, "_sc")
  for (p in predictors) {
    base[[p]] <- rep(stats::median(training[[p]], na.rm = TRUE), n)
  }
  base$y <- rep(stats::median(training$y, na.rm = TRUE), n)
  base
}

predict_ey <- function(nd) {
  mu_p  <- stats::predict(fit$fit, newdata = nd, what = "mu",
                          type = "response", data = training)
  nu_p  <- stats::predict(fit$fit, newdata = nd, what = "nu",
                          type = "response", data = training)
  tau_p <- stats::predict(fit$fit, newdata = nd, what = "tau",
                          type = "response", data = training)
  (tau_p + mu_p) / (1 + nu_p + tau_p) * 60
}

ey_panels <- lapply(predictors, function(p) {
  nd      <- make_base_nd(n_grid)
  raw_seq <- seq(min(training[[p]], na.rm = TRUE),
                 max(training[[p]], na.rm = TRUE),
                 length.out = n_grid)
  nd[[paste0(p, "_sc")]] <- (raw_seq - scale_params[[p]]$center) /
                            scale_params[[p]]$scale
  nd[[p]] <- raw_seq
  df <- data.frame(x = raw_seq, y = predict_ey(nd))
  log_x <- p == "tx_length"
  p_obj <- ggplot(df, aes(x, y)) +
    geom_line(color = "steelblue", linewidth = 0.9) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 60)) +
    scale_y_continuous(breaks = c(0, 10, 20, 30, 40, 50, 60)) +
    labs(x = p, y = "E[MAPQ]", title = p) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 9)
  if (log_x) p_obj <- p_obj + scale_x_log10()
  p_obj
})

patchwork::wrap_plots(ey_panels, nrow = 1)
```

# 5. Coefficient forest plot

Linear (parametric) coefficients for each BEINF parameter, with 95%
Wald confidence intervals. For `pb()` smoothers, the coefficient is the
linear part of the spline term — the "average direction" of the
relationship — while the smoother adds non-linear shape on top. The
dashed vertical line at zero marks no effect.

```{r forest_plot, fig.height = 6, fig.cap = "95% Wald CIs for parametric coefficients across BEINF parameters."}
get_coef_df <- function(model) {
  rows <- list()
  for (what in c("mu", "sigma", "nu", "tau")) {
    b <- tryCatch(stats::coef(model, what = what),
                  error = function(e) NULL)
    if (is.null(b) || length(b) == 0L) next
    se <- tryCatch({
      v <- stats::vcov(model, what = what)
      if (is.matrix(v)) sqrt(diag(v))[seq_along(b)]
      else if (is.numeric(v)) v[seq_along(b)]
      else rep(NA_real_, length(b))
    }, error = function(e) rep(NA_real_, length(b)))
    rows[[what]] <- data.frame(
      parameter = what,
      term      = names(b),
      estimate  = unname(b),
      se        = unname(se),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  }
  do.call(rbind, rows)
}

coef_df <- get_coef_df(fit$fit)
coef_df$lower <- coef_df$estimate - 1.96 * coef_df$se
coef_df$upper <- coef_df$estimate + 1.96 * coef_df$se
coef_df$parameter <- factor(coef_df$parameter,
                            levels = c("mu", "sigma", "nu", "tau"))

ggplot(coef_df, aes(x = estimate, y = term)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey60") +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = lower, xmax = upper), height = 0.2,
                 color = "steelblue", na.rm = TRUE) +
  geom_point(color = "steelblue", size = 1.6) +
  facet_wrap(~ parameter, scales = "free", ncol = 2) +
  labs(x = "Coefficient (link scale)", y = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
  theme(strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"))
```

```{r scoring_setup, eval = has_scored, include = FALSE}
flag_thresh <- attr(scored, "flag_threshold")
filt_method <- attr(scored, "filter_method")
threshold   <- attr(scored, "threshold")
n_total     <- nrow(scored)
n_scored    <- sum(!is.na(scored$rqr))
n_flagged   <- sum(scored$flag_low %in% TRUE)
```

```{r scoring_header, eval = has_scored, results = "asis"}
cat("# 6. Scoring summary\n\n")
cat(sprintf("- Filter method: **%s**\n", filt_method))
cat(sprintf("- Threshold:     **%g**\n", threshold))
cat(sprintf("- Residual cut:  RQR < %.3f\n", flag_thresh))
cat(sprintf("- Reads scored:  %d / %d\n", n_scored, n_total))
cat(sprintf("- Reads flagged: %d (%.2f%% of scored)\n",
            n_flagged, 100 * n_flagged / max(n_scored, 1)))
```

```{r rqr_scored_density, eval = has_scored, fig.height = 4, fig.cap = "RQR distribution on scored reads with flag threshold (red dashed)."}
ggplot(scored[!is.na(scored$rqr), ], aes(x = rqr)) +
  geom_density(fill = "steelblue", alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = flag_thresh, color = "red", linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(x = "RQR", y = "Density") +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r flags_header, eval = has_scored, results = "asis"}
cat("# 7. Where flags landed\n\n")
```

```{r flags_heatmap, eval = has_scored, fig.height = 5, fig.cap = "Flag rate (% reads flagged) by n_isoforms x pct_covered."}
pct_breaks <- seq(0, 100, by = 10)
pct_labels <- paste0(pct_breaks[-length(pct_breaks)], "-", pct_breaks[-1], "%")

hm <- scored |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(.data$rqr)) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    pct_cov_bin = cut(.data$pct_covered, breaks = pct_breaks,
                      include.lowest = TRUE, labels = pct_labels)
  ) |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(.data$pct_cov_bin)) |>
  dplyr::group_by(.data$n_isoforms, .data$pct_cov_bin) |>
  dplyr::summarise(n = dplyr::n(),
                   pct_flagged = mean(.data$flag_low) * 100,
                   .groups = "drop")

ggplot(hm, aes(x = factor(n_isoforms), y = pct_cov_bin, fill = pct_flagged)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_text(aes(label = ifelse(n >= 10,
                               paste0(round(pct_flagged, 1), "%"), "")),
            size = 2.2, color = "white") +
  scale_fill_distiller(palette = "Oranges", direction = 1,
                       name = "% flagged") +
  labs(x = "n_isoforms", y = "pct_covered bin") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 10)
```

```{r flag_by_niso, eval = has_scored, fig.height = 4, fig.cap = "Percent flagged by n_isoforms."}
scored |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(.data$rqr)) |>
  dplyr::group_by(.data$n_isoforms) |>
  dplyr::summarise(pct_flagged = mean(.data$flag_low) * 100, .groups = "drop") |>
  ggplot(aes(x = factor(n_isoforms), y = pct_flagged)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#D85A30", alpha = 0.85) +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(round(pct_flagged, 1), "%")),
            vjust = -0.4, size = 3) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15))) +
  labs(x = "n_isoforms", y = "% reads flagged") +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r mapq_by_flag, eval = has_scored, fig.height = 4, fig.cap = "MAPQ distribution by flag status."}
scored |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(.data$rqr)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = .data$MAPQ, fill = .data$flag_low)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.4) +
```
